title: gate.yaml
description: A project's gate settings, at the root of the project. Settings at the top apply to every pipeline; a pipeline's own settings win.

prepare.description: A command that readies the project in both the target branch's tree and this one before their runs, e.g. [npm, ci].

ignore.description: Glob patterns of project files that never change what the model gets, on top of documentation and CI; a change only there leaves every pipeline unchanged.

pipelines.description: Pipeline name to its version and test set. The name labels the comment and the artifact.

config.description: The version's config, relative to the project.

golden.description: The test set's directory, relative to the project.

manifest.description: Ids and hash the set must match, relative to the project.

inputs-url.description: Where a reader finds the set's non-text files: a URL with {path} or {name}.

k.description: Runs per case and version (default 1). The naive rule on the mean reads the first; the betting rule, the rule on checks and budgets use all. Ignored with max_spend_usd.

delta.description: The loss in points of the mean score that matters (default 5): the naive rule blocks a larger drop; the betting rule passes when the loss is shown to be smaller and blocks when shown to be larger.

alpha.description: How often the gate as a whole may block a candidate that is no worse (default 0.05). The gate splits it: half to the betting rule on the mean, half to the rule on checks, all to the rule on the mean when no check can block. The betting rule's share bounds its wrong passes of a loss over delta as well; the naive rule has no bound. A lower alpha needs more runs to decide.

mean.description: Rule on the mean (default naive): naive compares the first run of each version with delta; betting reads all runs and gives pass, block or inconclusive (needs k of at least 2).

checks.description: A check that broke over the runs (Fisher's exact test per case and check) blocks, or is only reported (default block).

levels.description: Importance of checks (default: every check normal). critical: blocks even under checks: report and leads the comment; minor: left out of the case's score, warns only when significantly worse. Shell-style patterns of check ids; cases maps case-id patterns to a level, and a minor case leaves the mean.

critical.description: Check ids or patterns that block under either mode of checks.

minor.description: Check ids or patterns left out of the case's score; they only warn.

cases.description: Case-id pattern to level, for checks without their own; the first match wins.

prices.description: A price file, relative to the project: model: [input, output] or [input, output, cached input], USD per 1M tokens.

budgets.description: Limits for the candidate. A pipeline's own budgets replaces the top-level mapping as a whole.

cost_per_run_usd.description: The candidate's mean cost per run; needs prices.

latency_s.description: Seconds for the candidate's latency quantile.

latency_quantile.description: Which quantile of the candidate's latencies latency_s limits (default 0.95).

base_max_age_days.description: The gate reuses the target branch's runs from earlier jobs up to this many days old instead of running its version again (default 7). With 0 it runs that version on every request.

max_spend_usd.description: Adaptive runs, instead of k (needs mean: betting and prices): the gate buys rounds, one run of every case by both versions, until it decides or the next round, priced like the last one, would take this job over this many USD. Checks and budgets are read once, on rounds 1 to 5. A re-run of the job continues where it stopped and counts the rounds already paid for.
